title: Responsible AI usage coach to 1,000+ medical software development community in 27 sessions in 2026
summary: I taught practical, compliant AI use in 27 sessions this year to more than 1,000 engineers, architects, managers and analysts, through Philips University, team requests and company events. A four-session series for an IGT-D engineering team drew 50, 46, 45, and 41 attendees, with satisfaction ratings from 7.21 to 8.17 out of 10.
what_would_have_happened: Teams would adopt AI unevenly, without shared guardrails for regulated work.
the_call: Teach one practical curriculum, with people making the final call.
what_i_did: Delivered Philips University courses, team-requested sessions and community series. For the four-session IGT-D series, I adapted each session to the team's needs, answered questions, and supported the India schedule from the United States.
what_changed: Average 8.7 out of 10 across 22 scored sessions; several communities asked for repeats. The IGT-D workshop organizer praised the series' structure, tailored content, and prompt responses.
